We spent six months building the wrong thing. Everyone on the team knew it, but nobody said it out loud. That's the real lesson about product-market fit: silence isn't agreement. We had seven enterprise pilots, three of which were paying, and we still decided to pivot because the retention numbers told the truth. The best thing we ever did was cancel the roadmap and go talk to customers. Twenty interviews in two weeks. That's it. If you're waiting for a signal, you already have it. What's the last time you talked to a customer who churned?
